name: value-props
description: Heading with calls to action, colour-bordered benefit cards two to a row, and a closing line. Ported from the live homepage section #ap-built-field-v2 (Figma: Why Teams Choose Asset Panda, 4331:24830).

primary_label.description: Primary (gradient) button text. Renders only with primary_url.

secondary_label.description: Secondary (outline) button text. Renders only with secondary_url.

items.description: Benefit cards, laid out two to a row. Each: title and body (required), optional accent (yellow, red, green, indigo; default cycles in that order). Titles keep line breaks.

closing.description: Centred closing line under the cards.

reveal.description: Stagger cards in on scroll. The live homepage section has no entrance animation (false).
